launchPhaseDetail: Tempo mainnet live since March 18 but KlarnaUSD still absent — USD1 (WLFI) launched on Tempo May 8 as first native stablecoin, beating KlarnaUSD to market; Bridge OCC charter approved Feb 2026; KlarnaUSD absent from Bridge Open Issuance live issuer list; Klarna Q1 2026 earnings May 14 is next likely update venue; IPO completed Sep 2025 (NYSE: KLAR), KlarnaUSD in F-1 prospectus as strategic initiative

milestones.title: Klarna announces KlarnaUSD, first bank stablecoin on Tempo
milestones.description: Built on Bridge (Stripe) Open Issuance infrastructure. 114M customers, $112B annual GMV as adoption base.
